a sprite sheet of 16 board game stepping stones in a clean 4 columns by 4 rows grid with generous empty space between them. Every stone is the same size and the same shape: a flat rounded-square stone slab with soft rounded edges seen from a 45 degree camera, with a simple raised emblem on a softly tinted top. Row 1: red flag on cream stone; a completely plain cream stone with no emblem; treasure chest on orange stone; wooden bench on lavender stone. Row 2: rolled paper scroll on beige stone; forked arrows on beige stone; question mark on teal stone; small castle on brick red stone. Row 3: wheat sheaf on golden stone; hyacinth flower on purple stone; broken column on grey stone; small clay figurine on terracotta stone. Row 4: witch hat on dark indigo stone; anchor on navy blue stone; round gazebo on mint stone; fishing hook on light blue stone
